Tattoo & Piercing Studio · Art Gallery

A safe, clean, and ultimately comfortable studio.

Locke Studios sits in the center of Gettysburg, a tattoo and piercing studio with a working art gallery, proud of its friendly staff and a clients-first approach to every project it accepts.

4.9 stars from 571 Google reviews Gettysburg Times Pick of the County, 2014 & 2015 Custom tattooing · Body piercing · Original art

What the shop does

Services

Custom tattoo work is the heart of the shop. Recent pieces from the floor are in the Flash Book below: black and grey portraits and sleeves, and color work like the platypus on the cover pages. Bring an idea in any state, from a finished sketch to a sentence, and the consultation shapes it from there.

The studio pierces as well as it tattoos. The daith piercing shown here is the shop's own work, photographed for its page. Questions about a piercing, jewelry, or healing start with a call or a message.

The name over the door says Tattoo & Art Gallery, and the room backs it up: original artwork hangs through the shop, including the large painting behind the front counter, and pieces are offered for sale in the studio.
